parameters.content:
## Config Explained

Every value lives in the **Config** node. Leave **DRY_RUN** set to true until a dry run report looks right.

**RENEWABLE_ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_IDS** Comma-separated achievement type IDs this reminder acts on. Anything not listed is ignored, even if it has a validity period. The IDs differ per instance, so look them up by name in your own instance. Do not copy them from another instance.

**NOTICE_PERIOD_MONTHS** How far ahead of expiry the reminder goes. Default 6.

**FLOOR_DATE** No reminder for any event that ended before this date.

A floor is **not interval neutral**. A five year certificate comes due 54 months after the event and a three year one at 30. A floor chosen for the three year group can exclude the five year group entirely. The workflow reports which intervals it excluded. If it excluded all of them, it stops with an explanation instead of running quietly.

**WINDOW_DAYS** Width of the due window, looking back from today's due date. 7 is a good production value because a missed run is picked up by the next one. Use a wider window while testing.

**DRY_RUN** True writes a report and sends nothing.

**MAX_PER_RUN** Throttle. It caps learners, not events, and applies before grouping, so a busy day can split one event across two runs. Anything held back turns the run red and is named in the run summary.

**ABORT_ABOVE** Safety net. A throttle limits how much is sent, but it still sends whatever fits even if the selection has gone wrong. ABORT_ABOVE refuses the whole run and sends nothing when the number of due learners is implausible.

**SENDING_ADDRESS_ID** The sending email address ID from your instance.

**TEMPLATE_ID** The communication template ID for the reminder email. The workflow refuses to send while this or the sending address is empty.

**SEND_AUDIENCE** `passed`. Sent alongside the learner list. The two intersect, so it can only narrow the recipients, never widen them.

**CATCHUP_FROM and CATCHUP_TO** An explicit event end date range that overrides the rolling window, for a one-time catch-up. Clear them afterwards. FLOOR_DATE still applies.

**TIMEZONE** Timezone the due window is calculated in. The Schedule Trigger uses the workflow timezone setting, not this value. Set both to the same zone, or 07:00 fires at the wrong hour.

**PAGE_SIZE** 100, the most Administrate returns per page.

---

**There is no list of courses.** This is deliberate. Add or remove courses on each course's Achievements tab in Administrate. The workflow does not need to change.

**Test instances.** A test instance may accept and log email without delivering it. A run there with DRY_RUN false tests the mutation, logging and deduplication, but not delivery.

nodes.notes: One event per iteration. Batch size 1 is load bearing: it is what makes Record Sent run per event instead of once at the end.
